name: Fredfades b2b Barbara Boeing (BR)
description:
Fred is back at Blå, this time bringing Barbara Boeing for an all night b2b.

Barbara Boeing is a Brazilian selector and producer currently based in Milan whose sets are driven by feeling, curiosity and an instinctive connection to the dance floor. Moving fluidly between wide range Latin sounds, disco, old-school house, Balearic, synth pop, early trance and left-field electronics, her selections are vibrant, emotionally charged and always unpredictable - music chosen for how it feels, not how it fits.
